task.title: Inspect one exact durable schedule
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/829 by exposing exact schedule lookup through deterministic read-only CLI JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Validate one exact schedule identity before storage access.
Return the complete projection or null for an absent valid identity.
Fail closed on malformed state without partial output or mutation authority.

attempts.diagnostic: Focused tests failed because get was not a recognized schedule subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the required success, absence or conflict, validation, and fail-closed paths.

attempts.summary: Implemented the bounded contract and refactored only demonstrated duplication.
attempts.diagnostic: The capability existed below the requested boundary or required one new typed kernel operation.
attempts.patch: Added validated read-only ScheduleStore::load routing and reused the complete schedule projection.

outcome.summary: Operators can distinguish a complete exact schedule from valid absence without direct storage access.

lessons: Preserve null as valid absence instead of conflating it with failure.
Keep exact lookup read-only and reuse the authoritative kernel projection.
